channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by remote code execution, command injection, and memory corruption flaws spanning desktop operating systems, web applications, and database middleware. Critical weaknesses in platforms such as IBM Maximo, Red Hat OpenShift, KubeVirt, and numerous consumer routers expose cloud orchestration, network infrastructure, and development environments to unauthenticated compromise. Concurrently, security gaps in AI inference tooling, mobile media decoders, and industrial control systems reveal an expanding attack surface targeting automation, edge devices, and operational technology. These findings emphasize the critical importance of strict input validation, robust container isolation, and rapid remediation of exposed credentials across enterprise and consumer deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-109556 — Desktop OS
item.description: This RCE vulnerability in EdgeEver Desktop's IPC handler lacks proper sender validation, allowing renderer processes to spawn arbitrary executables. It poses a direct threat to desktop applications built on web technologies where sandbox escapes can lead to full host compromise.

item.title: CVE-2025-71429 — Desktop OS
item.description: Unauthenticated OS command injection via GPT-SoVITS output folder paths enables remote attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands. Given the tool's popularity in voice synthesis workflows, this represents a high-value attack vector for local AI deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-58014 — Desktop OS
item.description: An off-by-one error in GLib's locale string parsing can trigger out-of-bounds memory access or denial of service. As GLib underpins numerous Linux desktop environments and system utilities, this flaw impacts broad desktop ecosystem stability.

item.title: CVE-2026-16118 — Desktop OS
item.description: A heap-based buffer overflow in xdgmime occurs when parsing malicious MIME magic files in user-writable directories. Attackers can exploit this to achieve code execution or crash desktop file-handling services.

item.title: CVE-2026-104077 — Desktop OS
item.description: Remote code execution via insufficient sanitization in Reveal.js slides allows malicious Markdown notes to bypass DOMPurify and execute arbitrary code on the host.

item.title: CVE-2026-109422 — Desktop OS
item.description: The renderer-process IPC bridge passes unvalidated URLs to ShellExecuteW, enabling remote code execution when attackers manipulate the client's navigation flow.

item.title: CVE-2026-109242 — Desktop OS
item.description: Uninitialized heap memory rendering in progressive RDP tiles can leak sensitive process data or cause client crashes when interacting with malicious servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-109390 — Desktop OS
item.description: A heap-based buffer overflow in AnyDesk allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root without user approval, posing a critical threat to remote desktop infrastructure.

item.title: CVE-2026-108094 — Desktop OS
item.description: Local attackers can trigger a use-after-free in the Wayland compositor via malicious ICC profiles, potentially crashing the desktop environment or escalating privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-79992 — Desktop OS
item.description: Maliciously crafted filenames processed by Emacs TRAMP can inject shell metacharacters, enabling local command execution on developer workstations.

item.title: CVE-2026-59090 — Desktop OS
item.description: Unsigned integer underflow in GIMP's PSD parser causes parser confusion, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary data and potentially achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-66758 — Desktop OS
item.description: Integer overflow in GIMP's FITS plugin results in undersized heap allocations during image processing, leading to memory corruption and potential exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2026-42169 — Desktop OS
item.description: Heap buffer overflow in GIMP's APNG and DDS loaders triggers when crafted image dimensions exceed bounds, enabling arbitrary code execution via malicious files.

item.title: CVE-2026-108982 — Desktop OS
item.description: VeraCrypt on macOS fails to terminate auxiliary FUSE-T processes after volume dismount, leaving decrypted data accessible to local attackers.

item.title: CVE-2026-21125 — Mobile Security
item.description: Improper input validation in Samsung's HEIF decoder allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code, directly compromising mobile device integrity and media processing pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-21120 — Mobile Security
item.description: A use-after-free flaw in Samsung's WSM service enables local privilege escalation to system level, breaching mobile OS security boundaries.

item.title: CVE-2026-66086 — Mobile Security
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in the Unisoc modem OTA stack enables remote code execution via malicious cellular broadcast messages without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-21139 — Mobile Security
item.description: Improper access control in Samsung Continuity Service permits adjacent attackers to manipulate paired mobile devices, potentially compromising user data and session continuity.

item.title: CVE-2026-92876 — IoT Security
item.description: Uncontrolled recursion in the IBM Maximo Application Suite IoT component can trigger severe denial of service. This directly threatens the availability of industrial IoT management platforms and connected device telemetry pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-75881 — IoT Security
item.description: An infinite parsing loop in the IoT component causes resource exhaustion when processing specific inputs. Maintaining continuous data ingestion from field sensors relies on mitigating this flaw to prevent operational downtime.

item.title: CVE-2026-108918 — IoT Security
item.description: Publicly disclosed remote command injection in the router's WLAN configuration form allows attackers to fully compromise the device and pivot to internal networks.

item.title: CVE-2026-78306 — IoT Security
item.description: Unauthenticated Bluetooth interface on DJI drones permits attackers within range to modify Wi-Fi credentials and regulatory settings, enabling full device takeover.

item.title: CVE-2021-47796 — IoT Security
item.description: Denver SHO-110 IP cameras expose an unauthenticated HTTP snapshot endpoint, allowing remote adversaries to stream live video feeds without credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-108890 — IoT Security
item.description: OS command injection in the Pi Agent Dashboard terminal handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on embedded monitoring devices.

item.title: CVE-2026-90920 — Cloud Security
item.description: Improper control of code generation in IBM Maximo AI Service allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. This critical flaw undermines cloud AI workloads and could lead to complete tenant isolation breaches.

item.title: CVE-2026-54099 — Cloud Security
item.description: The Windows Machine Config Operator's CSR auto-approver fails to reject Certificate Signing Requests containing additional organization values like system:masters. Compromised nodes can leverage this to escalate privileges across Red Hat OpenShift clusters.

item.title: CVE-2026-109569 — Cloud Security
item.description: Container escape in sandboxed.sh allows workspace code to access the host filesystem via nsenter without root namespace restriction. This breaks fundamental cloud development isolation guarantees and exposes host data to rogue containers.

item.title: CVE-2026-13201 — Cloud Security
item.description: KubeVirt's safepath package resolves symlinks via /proc/self/fd/N despite using O_NOFOLLOW, enabling path traversal attacks. This flaw compromises virtual machine security boundaries in Kubernetes environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-66788 — Cloud Security
item.description: Compromised spoke clusters can inject unauthorized endpoints into broker namespaces by exploiting label-driven resource injection, disrupting multi-cluster Kubernetes deployments.

item.title: CVE-2026-96275 — Cloud Security
item.description: Malicious Flatpak repositories can write to arbitrary host locations via extra data extraction, executing as root on system installs and compromising build pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-107935 — Cloud Security
item.description: Unauthenticated path traversal in gvproxy allows attackers to delete arbitrary files on the host system, representing a critical container-to-host escape vector.

item.title: CVE-2026-15581 — Cloud Security
item.description: TrustyAI Service lacks proper network segmentation, allowing any cluster pod to bypass authentication and tamper with monitoring APIs and configurations.

item.title: CVE-2026-108836 — Cloud Security
item.description: SSRF vulnerability in Ollama's Pull API enables remote attackers to force the server to fetch malicious resources, compromising AI inference environments.

item.title: CVE-2026-109575 — Network Devices
item.description: Improper authentication logic in the Data Plane API drops security controls across multiple transports, enabling unauthorized remote management of HAProxy instances.

item.title: CVE-2026-108929 — Network Devices
item.description: Remote argument injection in the DDNS CGI function allows attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on network routers without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-108896 — Network Devices
item.description: Multiple remote OS command injections and stack-based buffer overflows in Linksys E1700 router firmware allow unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise home networks.

item.title: CVE-2026-103903 — Network Devices
item.description: Flaws in MikroTik RouterOS WinBox authentication enable low-privilege users to extract authorization policies for other accounts, facilitating lateral movement.

item.title: CVE-2026-96515 — Network Devices
item.description: Insufficient input validation in Netlink ICT router diagnostics allows authenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary scripts, leading to complete device control.

item.title: CVE-2026-108804 — Network Devices
item.description: Critical OS command injection in TRENDnet router firmware allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full device control and pivot to internal networks.

item.title: CVE-2026-32645 — Industrial Control
item.description: Persistent default factory credentials with administrative access remain active even after custom accounts are configured. This severely weakens Red Lion Controls PLC/SCADA devices, enabling immediate unauthorized network access.

item.title: CVE-2026-39460 — Industrial Control
item.description: Plaintext storage of usernames and passwords in configuration files accessible via TFTP or CLI allows credential theft. Attackers can extract these credentials to pivot laterally across unprotected OT networks.

item.title: CVE-2026-108798 — Industrial Control
item.description: Use of a hard-coded cryptographic key in ZKTeco BioTime undermines encryption guarantees for physical access control logs, facilitating unauthorized system tampering.

item.title: CVE-2026-96119 — Web Security
item.description: Improper data sanitization in IBM i's HTTP Server Administration web application enables remote authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or exfiltrate sensitive information. The web-facing nature of this admin interface makes it a prime target for exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2026-85531 — Web Security
item.description: Cryptographic signature spoofing in the OpenCart Virtual POS Module allows attackers to forge transaction signatures by bypassing validation checks. This creates direct financial fraud risks for e-commerce platforms processing electronic money.

item.title: CVE-2026-109667 — Web Security
item.description: Privilege escalation in Frappe ERPNext allows any authenticated user to create records with disabled permission checks. This undermines multi-tenant data segregation and can grant unauthorized users administrative capabilities.

item.title: CVE-2026-109566 — Web Security
item.description: Hardcoded super-admin credentials in Rapyd Admin allow unauthenticated attackers to gain full system control via a seeded installer account. This trivially bypasses authentication mechanisms and requires immediate patching.

item.title: CVE-2026-87744 — Web Security
item.description: Unauthenticated bypass of security controls on generated Quarkus endpoints occurs when developers customize operations without explicitly re-declaring required security roles.

item.title: CVE-2026-109321 — Web Security
item.description: Deterministic unsalted MD5 hashing for OAuth-provisioned accounts enables offline credential cracking and widespread account takeover by remote attackers.

item.title: CVE-2026-109305 — Web Security
item.description: A Twig sandbox bypass allows non-admin users to invoke arbitrary PHP callables like passthru through templated views, leading to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-94503 — Web Security
item.description: Unrestricted upload of dangerous file types in PX-lab Zombify allows direct web shell deployment, granting immediate remote code execution on targeted servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-105407 — Web Security
item.description: Dassault Systèmes Tuleap suffers from multiple critical flaws including OS command injection, stored XSS, and SQLi, severely impacting enterprise collaboration workflows.

item.title: CVE-2026-109186 — Web Security
item.description: Mass assignment vulnerability in jshERP enables authenticated users to overwrite protected fields like tenant_id and passwords, breaking multi-tenant isolation.

item.title: CVE-2026-108900 — Web Security
item.description: Remote blind SQL injection in Exponent CMS XML-RPC login functionality allows unauthenticated attackers to extract database contents or escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-108980 — Web Security
item.description: Directory traversal flaw in Blinko's plugin installation mechanism allows authenticated users to overwrite root-owned startup files, leading to privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-108799 — Web Security
item.description: Manipulation of the email argument in jackq XCMS password recovery endpoint enables account takeover attempts and information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2026-108783 — Web Security
item.description: Presence of default credentials in PRVTPRO Amnezia-Web-Panel exposes backup download functionality to immediate unauthorized access and data exfiltration.

item.title: CVE-2026-81932 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SQL injection in IBM Guardium Data Protection's edge-controller allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate backend database contents. This compromises data integrity and bypasses core database monitoring and protection features.

item.title: CVE-2026-108474 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: SQL injection in JetBrains Exposed via unescaped string arguments affects a widely adopted Kotlin database framework. Developers relying on this middleware face widespread exploitation risks if input validation is not enforced.

item.title: CVE-2026-18166 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Improper authorization in IBM Db2's CREATE WRAPPER command allows authenticated users to expose sensitive database information. This metadata leakage can aid attackers in mapping internal database architectures for further exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2026-85457 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in IBM Planning Analytics enables remote authenticated code execution. Exploiting this vulnerability compromises backend analytical workloads and grants full control over the middleware environment.

item.title: CVE-2026-96012 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Privilege escalation in IBM Db2 Mirror allows authenticated attackers to bypass authorization checks and execute malicious code with elevated database privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-85965 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Memory-safety defects in the JavaScript engine integration can result in controlled process failures or memory corruption when processing complex queries.

item.title: CVE-2026-109343 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: The SurrealQL USE statement lacks proper authorization checks, allowing authenticated users to switch tenants and access restricted cross-tenant data.

item.title: CVE-2026-85955 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Progress MarkLogic Server XQuery evaluation bypass allows remote attackers to execute server-side code with elevated privileges, risking full database compromise.

item.title: CVE-2026-92681 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Neo4j GraphQL silently ignores schema-level authentication directives for @cypher fields, effectively disabling security controls for graph database queries.

item.title: CVE-2026-106445 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Handlebars prototype pollution via constructor bypass enables arbitrary code execution during template rendering, affecting widespread JavaScript middleware stacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-12894 — Databases & Middleware
item.description: Quarkus Qute template engine fails to restrict reflection access to sensitive Java internals, allowing template-based remote code execution in Java applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-49483 — Other
item.description: Component integrity bypass in Code for IBMi allows installation of unverified ILE components after superficial procedure checks. This introduces supply chain risks into midrange development environments and compiler toolchains.

item.title: CVE-2026-109560 — Other
item.description: Permission bypass in Continue CLI allows chaining unapproved commands after allowed Bash prefixes. AI-assisted coding agents can be manipulated to execute arbitrary shell operations, posing significant developer environment risks.

item.title: CVE-2026-109563 — Other
item.description: Quadratic backtracking in N3.js's N3Lexer triggers regular expression denial of service on long digit runs. Processing untrusted RDF or Turtle data can freeze Node.js event loops and degrade application responsiveness.

item.title: CVE-2026-96265 — Other
item.description: Authenticated service processor mailbox messages can overflow host firmware attribute storage to read or modify Hostboot memory regions. This undermines hardware-level security boundaries and firmware trust chains on IBM Power Systems.

item.title: CVE-2026-109360 — Other
item.description: Plaintext HTTP download of pretrained model weights enables on-path attackers to substitute crafted files for remote code execution within AI inference pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-109359 — Other
item.description: Improper manifest verification in secure enclave coordination allows replay attacks where withdrawn workloads regain trust and access to protected resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-103060 — Other
item.description: Path traversal in Erlang rebar3 package manager allows malicious publishers to overwrite project directories during dependency resolution, introducing supply chain risks.

item.title: CVE-2026-109391 — Other
item.description: Insecure deserialization in Square Squash allows unauthenticated attackers to store crafted YAML payloads, triggering remote code execution during symbolication processes.

item.title: CVE-2026-11837 — Other
item.description: Ansible's authorized_key module uses insecure file handling that enables local privilege escalation via symlink pre-staging, compromising automation pipelines.

item.title: CVE-2026-87690 — Other
item.description: Relative path traversal in Metasploit's iOS gather module exploits controlled file names from compromised devices, exposing sensitive host system paths.

item.title: CVE-2026-108985 — Other
item.description: Out-of-bounds write in libnfs ZDR decoding occurs when caller-supplied size limits are ignored, risking memory corruption in NFS client applications.
